display_information.name: Scout
display_information.description: Your Scout run summaries and replies, posted by Scout instead of as you.
display_information.long_description: Scout is an autonomous briefing and knowledge-management assistant that runs on your own Mac. This app gives it its own Slack identity: run summaries and replies to your feedback arrive as direct messages from Scout, so they notify you and never look like messages you wrote. The app can only post; it cannot read channels or messages. Source: https://github.com/Raven-Scout/Scout
